name: flight-radar
description: Real-time 3D flight tracker with Material 3 Expressive design
author: Jonathan Birge

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix electron install && node scripts/copy-cesium.js && node scripts/download-fonts.js
scripts.pull-data: node scripts/download-airports.js && node scripts/download-airspace.js && node scripts/download-waypoints.js && node scripts/promote-airports.js
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync @capacitor-community/electron
scripts.start: npm run cap:sync && npm --prefix electron run electron:start
scripts.pack: npm run cap:sync && npm --prefix electron run electron:pack
scripts.dist: npm run cap:sync && npm --prefix electron run electron:make
